# sgeos.github.io

> Brendan Sechter's technical blog, a personal notebook on systems programming,
> compilation and language design, hardware description, aerospace systems, mathematics
> and research funding, with long-form series and cited references in Chicago
> author-date style.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is an index for language models and agents
that read the site or its repository from outside. Links are absolute, so the file works
when fetched on its own.

## Start Here

- [About](https://sgeos.github.io/about/): who writes the blog and what it covers.
- [Categories](https://sgeos.github.io/categories.html): every post, grouped by subject.
- [Feed](https://sgeos.github.io/feed.json): recent posts in JSON Feed form.

## Repository

- [README](https://github.com/sgeos/sgeos.github.io/blob/master/README.md): what the repository holds and how to build it.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgeos/sgeos.github.io/blob/master/AGENTS.md): onboarding for any AI assistant.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/sgeos/sgeos.github.io/blob/master/CLAUDE.md): authoritative project context and conventions.
